nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of industry P10/P50/P90 benchmark bands for CAPEX/MW, LCOE, project/equity IRR and capacity factor used to rank a project's KPIs.

nodes.name: PercentileRanking
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass capturing a single metric's value, computed percentile, qualitative rating and the P10/P50/P90 reference band.

nodes.name: normalize_kpis_by_capacity
nodes.summary: Divides raw project KPIs by capacity, capex, generation and opex to produce a NormalizedKPIs record on per-MW/per-MWh bases for size-agnostic comparison.

nodes.name: calculate_percentile_ranking
nodes.summary: Interpolates a metric value against P10/P50/P90 anchors (honoring lower-is-better metrics) and returns a PercentileRanking with a qualitative rating.

nodes.name: benchmark_normalized_kpis
nodes.summary: Ranks a set of normalized KPIs against industry benchmark bands, returning per-metric PercentileRanking results for CAPEX, LCOE and IRR metrics.

nodes.name: compare_projects
nodes.summary: Sorts and compares multiple normalized projects by a chosen metric to support portfolio-level ranking and selection.

nodes.name: evaluation_v14.py
nodes.summary: Core v14 evaluation gateway: loads scenario configs, applies dotted/deep-merge overrides, runs the enhanced pipeline, normalizes KPIs and provides the CASPER tail-risk evaluation entry used across analytics.

nodes.name: _deep_merge_config
nodes.summary: Recursively deep-merges override dicts into a base scenario config without mutating inputs, used to apply scenario parameter overrides.

nodes.name: _expand_dotted_overrides
nodes.summary: Expands dotted-key overrides (e.g. Financing_Terms.debt_ratio) into nested dict structures so they can be deep-merged into a config.

nodes.name: normalize_kpi_dict
nodes.summary: Coerces a raw KPI mapping into a clean float-valued dict, dropping or logging non-numeric entries for downstream consumers.

nodes.name: _run_pipeline_with_config
nodes.summary: Invokes the enhanced v14 pipeline with a resolved config and validation modules, returning the full pipeline result while enforcing type expectations.

nodes.name: evaluate_scenario_from_dict
nodes.summary: Evaluates an in-memory scenario config dict with optional overrides and returns normalized KPIs without touching the filesystem.

nodes.name: evaluate_with_overrides
nodes.summary: Primary gateway that loads a scenario YAML, applies overrides, runs the pipeline and returns normalized KPIs (or the full result) — the canonical evaluation entry point.

nodes.name: evaluate_with_casper_tail_risk
nodes.summary: Runs the pipeline then layers Monte-Carlo and sensitivity tail-risk enrichment to produce a CasperResult, building the bankability/downside view for a scenario.

nodes.name: evaluation_v14_legacy.py
nodes.summary: Backward-compatibility shim mapping the legacy camelCase evaluatewithoverrides name onto the canonical snake_case evaluate_with_overrides gateway.

nodes.name: evaluatewithoverrides
nodes.summary: Legacy camelCase forwarder that delegates to the canonical evaluate_with_overrides gateway for pre-refactor callers.

nodes.name: evaluationv14.py
nodes.summary: Backward-compatibility shim exposing the legacy module name analytics.evaluationv14 that forwards evaluatewithoverrides to the canonical evaluation gateway.

nodes.name: optimization_v14.py
nodes.summary: Generic single-parameter optimizer that sweeps a config parameter across a range and returns the value maximizing/minimizing a target KPI subject to a KPI constraint (e.g. max equity IRR within DSCR covenant).

nodes.name: OptimizationResult
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding an optimization run's parameter path, objective/constraint keys, best feasible point and the full sweep curve.

nodes.name: optimize_parameter
nodes.summary: Sweeps a config parameter across a linspace, evaluates the v14 pipeline at each step and selects the best feasible value for the objective KPI under an optional constraint.

nodes.name: sensitivity/optimizer.py
nodes.summary: Multi-objective Pareto optimization engine: builds grid/LHS sampling plans over parameter grids, evaluates each via the pipeline, computes the non-dominated Pareto frontier and exports result tables.

nodes.name: ParameterGridSpec
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing one swept parameter (name, override key, candidate values) used to build grid and LHS sampling plans.

nodes.name: ParetoPoint
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for a single evaluated point in the Pareto search, holding its label, overrides, objective values and KPIs.

nodes.name: ParetoResult
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass bundling the objectives, parameter grid, all evaluated points, the non-dominated Pareto subset and run metadata.

nodes.name: pareto_frontier
nodes.summary: Computes the non-dominated (Pareto-optimal) subset of evaluated points across multiple normalized objectives using direction-aware dominance checks.

nodes.name: build_grid_plan
nodes.summary: Builds a full cartesian-product grid sampling plan over the parameter grid, capping the number of points to a configured maximum.

nodes.name: build_lhs_plan
nodes.summary: Builds a Latin-hypercube sampling plan over the parameter grid with a seeded RNG for reproducible space-filling Pareto searches.

nodes.name: run_pareto_search
nodes.summary: Drives a full Pareto search: generates a grid/LHS plan, evaluates each parameter combination through the pipeline, collects objective KPIs and returns the Pareto frontier result.

nodes.name: export_pareto_table
nodes.summary: Flattens a Pareto result (all or frontier-only points) into a pandas DataFrame of objectives and overrides for reporting/export.

nodes.name: sensitivity_pareto.py
nodes.summary: Legacy shim re-exporting the Pareto optimization API from analytics.sensitivity.optimizer and providing an insight-driven optimize_from_sensitivity_insights convenience wrapper.

nodes.name: optimize_from_sensitivity_insights
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that runs a Pareto search over a parameter grid and objectives by delegating to run_pareto_search in the canonical optimizer.

nodes.name: wacc_sensitivity.py
nodes.summary: Sweeps the cost-of-equity (ke) band, recomputes the build-up WACC from the actually sized debt and reports project and equity NPV swings to expose the discount-rate knife-edge for a frontier market.

nodes.name: ke_band_npv
nodes.summary: Iterates over a band of cost-of-equity values, re-evaluates the scenario to recompute WACC-driven NPVs and returns the project/equity NPV swing per ke.

nodes.name: losses_model.py
nodes.summary: Defines the wind-farm loss taxonomy and the multiplicative net-factor model that converts gross AEP to net AEP, applying wake, availability, electrical, and other component losses as retention factors. Loads default taxonomy from YAML and computes net capacity factor.

nodes.name: default_loss_taxonomy
nodes.summary: Loads and normalizes the default loss taxonomy from the YAML defaults file, classifying each loss key as availability or non-availability for correct retention handling.

nodes.name: LossResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass capturing the outcome of applying losses: gross and net AEP, net retention factor, total loss percentage, and per-component breakdown.

nodes.name: _component_retentions
nodes.summary: Converts each loss-percentage entry into a per-component retention factor against the taxonomy, supporting exclusion of selected components for sensitivity runs.

nodes.name: compute_net_factor
nodes.summary: Computes the overall net retention factor by multiplying all component retentions, the single multiplier that scales gross AEP to net AEP.

nodes.name: apply_losses
nodes.summary: Applies the full loss taxonomy to a gross AEP value and returns a LossResult with net AEP, retention factor, total loss percentage, and component breakdown.

nodes.name: net_capacity_factor
nodes.summary: Derives the net capacity factor from net AEP, installed capacity, and annual hours, the key bankability metric linking energy yield to nameplate.

nodes.name: build_aep_losses_block
nodes.summary: Assembles the AEP losses summary block (gross, net, total loss, net capacity factor, and per-component detail) for inclusion in the AEP summary output.

nodes.name: mc_aep_weibull.py
nodes.summary: Fits a Weibull distribution from a wind-speed series and runs a Monte Carlo AEP simulation by perturbing the Weibull scale/shape, computing per-sample net AEP and exceedance percentiles. Writes a Monte Carlo summary CSV.

nodes.name: WeibullFit
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding a fitted Weibull distribution: scale parameter a, shape parameter k, mean wind speed, and observation count.

nodes.name: fit_weibull_from_series
nodes.summary: Fits Weibull scale and shape parameters from a wind-speed series using mean/standard-deviation moment matching with a gamma-function correction.

nodes.name: run_mc_aep
nodes.summary: Runs the Weibull-based Monte Carlo AEP: samples uncertain Weibull parameters, integrates each against the power curve, applies losses, and returns mean/std and P50/P75/P90 exceedance levels.

nodes.name: write_mc_summary_csv
nodes.summary: Serializes Monte Carlo AEP results (percentiles, mean, std, sample count) to a rounded summary CSV for reporting.

nodes.name: pipeline_aep_v14.py
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the v14 AEP integration pipeline: loads the AEP summary, validates turbine specs against config (count, rating, total capacity), and optionally runs the Monte Carlo step before injecting AEP into the finance config.

nodes.name: validate_turbine_specs
nodes.summary: Cross-checks turbine count, per-unit rating, and total installed capacity between the config and the loaded AEP data, raising on any inconsistency to protect the capacity-factor chain.

nodes.name: integrate_aep_pipeline
nodes.summary: Full config-driven AEP pipeline that loads the summary, validates turbine specs, optionally runs Monte Carlo with config-supplied Weibull and loss parameters, and returns the integrated result.

nodes.name: wind_integration.py
nodes.summary: High-level wind-to-finance integration bridge for the v14 pipeline: loads AEP from the Data Lake, runs AEP Monte Carlo, extracts P-values, reverse-derives capacity factor from AEP, and injects AEP results into the finance config.

nodes.name: load_aep_for_project
nodes.summary: Loads project AEP data from a summary path with optional manifest validation, gracefully handling missing optional wind modules for the finance pipeline.

nodes.name: run_aep_monte_carlo
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper that runs the AEP Monte Carlo simulation for a project, returning percentile and uncertainty results for downstream risk integration.

nodes.name: compute_aep_p_values
nodes.summary: Extracts requested P-value exceedance levels (P50/P75/P90/P99) from Monte Carlo AEP results for bankability reporting.

nodes.name: derive_capacity_factor_from_aep
nodes.summary: Reverse-engineers the net capacity factor from net AEP, installed capacity, and project life, warning when the derived factor falls outside plausible bounds.

nodes.name: integrate_aep_into_config
nodes.summary: Injects loaded AEP data and optional Monte Carlo results into the finance config, setting net AEP, capacity factor, and P-value fields while preserving config provenance.

nodes.name: bankable_aep.py
nodes.summary: Bankable AEP core: computes gross AEP from a Weibull distribution with air-density correction, models wake losses via PyWake, defines the uncertainty budget, and derives P50/P75/P90 exceedance levels for one-year and project-life horizons.

nodes.name: density_velocity_factor
nodes.summary: Computes the wind-speed scaling factor for site versus reference air density, the basis for IEC air-density correction of power output.

nodes.name: GrossAEPResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding gross AEP outputs: capacity factor, per-turbine and farm-level energy, turbine count, and the applied density factor.

nodes.name: gross_aep_weibull
nodes.summary: Computes gross farm AEP by integrating a Weibull wind distribution against the power curve with density correction and cut-in/cut-out limits, returning a GrossAEPResult.

nodes.name: WakeResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass capturing wake-loss modeling output: wake-loss percentage, deficit model used, turbine count, and gross versus wake-adjusted AEP.

nodes.name: model_wake_loss
nodes.summary: Models inter-turbine wake losses using PyWake (Gaussian/Bastankhah deficit models) over the turbine layout and wind rose, returning the wake-loss percentage and adjusted AEP.

nodes.name: UncertaintyBudget
nodes.summary: Dataclass and methods modeling the wind-resource uncertainty budget, combining wind-measurement, long-term, extrapolation, power-curve, wake, and interannual sigmas into systematic and combined uncertainty.

nodes.name: ExceedanceResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding bankable exceedance outputs: P50/P75/P90 for one-year and project-life horizons plus the underlying sigmas and life span.

nodes.name: exceedance_levels
nodes.summary: Derives P50/P75/P90 exceedance levels for one-year and project-life horizons from the P50 AEP and the combined uncertainty budget, applying a P50 haircut and correlation.

nodes.name: aep_loader.py
nodes.summary: EPC AEP resource loader that reads pre-computed AEP summaries from the Data Lake with source-ID validation against an approved manifest, SHA-256 checksum verification, and IEC-standard provenance tracking. Guards against placeholder sources and enforces config-sourced provenance rather than hardcoded values.

nodes.name: register_approved_source
nodes.summary: Registers an approved AEP data source in the global manifest after validating its metadata, supporting multi-source (OEM/NREL/ECMWF) provenance with overwrite control.

nodes.name: load_approved_sources_from_yaml
nodes.summary: Loads the approved-source manifest from a YAML config file and registers each entry, enforcing config-driven source provenance per GWTF ARCH-01.

nodes.name: load_aep_from_summary
nodes.summary: Core loader that reads an AEP summary (JSON or CSV) from disk, validates its source against the approved manifest, computes a SHA-256 checksum, and returns the enriched AEP data block with provenance metadata.

nodes.name: export_provenance_report
nodes.summary: Writes a human-readable provenance report (JSON and text) documenting the AEP data source, checksum, and IEC standard for audit and bankability review.

nodes.name: assert_source_in_manifest
nodes.summary: Raises a KeyError listing approved source IDs when the requested source is missing from the manifest, enforcing strict source whitelisting.

nodes.name: is_placeholder_source
nodes.summary: Detects whether a manifest source is a placeholder/non-certified entry by inspecting its flags and description, preventing placeholder data from reaching bankable outputs.

nodes.name: build_provenance_aep_block
nodes.summary: Assembles the provenance metadata block for an AEP result, linking the source ID, derivation chain, and manifest entry into a single auditable structure.

nodes.name: validate_config_aep_provenance
nodes.summary: Validates that a finance config references an approved, non-placeholder AEP source with a certified OEM power curve, optionally allowing placeholders for development runs.

nodes.name: oem_parser.py
nodes.summary: Parses the manufacturer-certified Envision EN-171/6.5 MW power curve from the canonical config store, applies IEC 61400-12-1 air-density correction, and computes AEP from 8760-hour wind distributions with PCHIP/cubic-spline interpolation. Removed a prior hardcoded placeholder curve in favor of config-sourced data.

nodes.name: _load_curve_entry
nodes.summary: Loads a single power-curve entry by key from the YAML curve store, raising a descriptive KeyError when the requested curve is absent.

nodes.name: _build_base_curve
nodes.summary: Constructs the base wind-speed/power DataFrame from a raw curve entry, interpolating onto a uniform grid for downstream AEP computation.

nodes.name: _apply_air_density_correction
nodes.summary: Applies site-specific air-density correction to a base power curve per IEC 61400-12-1:2022, scaling wind speeds to account for deviations from reference density.

nodes.name: parse_power_curve
nodes.summary: Public entry point that loads a named curve, builds its base DataFrame and specs, and returns the air-density-corrected power curve for the given site density.

nodes.name: interpolate_power_curve
nodes.summary: Interpolates a power curve onto arbitrary wind speeds using monotonic PCHIP or cubic-spline methods, clipping to rated power to avoid overshoot artifacts.

nodes.name: compute_aep_from_curve
nodes.summary: Computes farm-level annual energy production from an 8760-hour wind distribution and power curve, optionally applying wake, availability, and electrical losses to derive net AEP.

nodes.name: validate_power_curve_iec_compliance
nodes.summary: Checks a power curve for IEC compliance by verifying monotonicity, rated-power plateau, and cut-in behavior, returning a structured validation result.

nodes.name: monte_carlo_aep.py
nodes.summary: Runs a 100k-scenario Monte Carlo simulation of AEP uncertainty, sampling Weibull parameters and loss factors to produce P50/P75/P90/P99 percentiles and confidence intervals for lender-grade risk quantification. Optionally exports per-scenario results to Parquet.

nodes.name: run_monte_carlo_aep
nodes.summary: Drives the AEP Monte Carlo: loads the AEP summary, samples Weibull and loss distributions across scenarios, computes per-scenario AEP from the power curve, and returns percentiles, confidence intervals, and summary statistics.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Public API package initializer for the wind analytics package, re-exporting AEP loading, Monte Carlo, capacity-factor derivation, and config-integration entry points for the DutchBay v14 finance model.

nodes.name: aep_summary_builder.py
nodes.summary: Builds a complete AEP summary from a finance config: validates curve selection against the manifest, parses the OEM power curve, computes gross AEP and losses, derives P50/P90 exceedance levels and net capacity factor, and writes the provenance-tagged summary to disk.

nodes.name: validate_curve_selection
nodes.summary: Validates that the config-selected power-curve source exists in the manifest and parses correctly, raising descriptive errors for missing or mismatched curve selections.

nodes.name: _uncertainty_from_config
nodes.summary: Constructs an UncertaintyBudget from the resource config's uncertainty block, mapping wind-measurement, long-term, power-curve, and wake-model sigmas for exceedance calculations.

nodes.name: build_aep_summary_from_config
nodes.summary: Core builder that turns a finance config into a full AEP summary dict, computing gross AEP, applying the loss taxonomy, deriving exceedance levels and net capacity factor, and attaching provenance.

nodes.name: aep_tornado.py
nodes.summary: Builds an AEP sensitivity (tornado) analysis by swinging wind bias, shear, hub-height, alternate-curve, and loss-component drivers around a base case and ranking each driver by its impact on net AEP. Outputs a sorted swing table to CSV.

nodes.name: AEPTornadoConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding the AEP tornado sensitivity ranges: wind bias, shear delta, relative loss perturbation, reference/hub heights, and an alternate power-curve key.

nodes.name: gross_aep_farm_gwh
nodes.summary: Computes gross farm AEP in GWh by integrating the Weibull wind distribution against the power curve over all turbines, the analytical backbone of the tornado swings.

nodes.name: run_aep_tornado
nodes.summary: Runs the tornado analysis: perturbs each AEP driver up and down, recomputes net AEP, and returns a DataFrame of swings sorted by absolute impact for sensitivity ranking.

nodes.name: tornado_from_config
nodes.summary: Driver that extracts Weibull parameters, losses, and curve selection from a finance config and runs the AEP tornado, returning the ranked sensitivity table.

nodes.name: pipeline_analytics_v14.py
nodes.summary: Enhanced V14 pipeline that wraps the base wind-to-finance pipeline with optional, config-driven analytics: returns (project/equity IRR/NPV/MIRR), tail-risk (VaR/CVaR), sensitivity tornados, scenario comparison, and Monte Carlo. Each analytics module degrades gracefully when its dependency is unavailable.

nodes.name: AnalyticsEnablement
nodes.summary: Pydantic contract recording which analytics modules were requested versus actually available at runtime (returns, risk, sensitivity, monte_carlo, scenario_comparison).

nodes.name: SensitivityPoint
nodes.summary: Data record for a single sensitivity sample, capturing a parameter, its variation percentage, and the resulting project NPV, project IRR, and minimum DSCR.

nodes.name: SensitivityAnalysisResult
nodes.summary: Aggregated sensitivity result holding the parameters tested, all sensitivity points, base-case NPV/IRR/DSCR, and the NPV-impact ranking used to build tornado charts.

nodes.name: ScenarioComparisonResult
nodes.summary: Comparison contract across named scenarios, collecting project and equity NPV/IRR, min DSCR, and the NPV/IRR ranges spanning the scenario set.

nodes.name: MonteCarloResult
nodes.summary: Monte Carlo output contract storing iteration count, project NPV mean/std/P10/P50/P90, project IRR mean/std, and the full NPV and IRR distributions.

nodes.name: EnhancedAnalyticsResult
nodes.summary: Top-level analytics envelope combining the base pipeline result with the optional returns, risk, sensitivity, monte_carlo, and scenario_comparison sub-results and an enablement flag set.

nodes.name: _calculate_returns_analysis
nodes.summary: Builds the equity/project returns analysis from the base pipeline result by extracting CFADS and debt-service series and delegating to the returns engine's summarize_all_returns.

nodes.name: _calculate_risk_analysis
nodes.summary: Computes tail-risk metrics (VaR/CVaR and percentile analysis) over the cashflow distribution using TailRiskAnalyzer configured from the scenario's risk and returns blocks.

nodes.name: _calculate_sensitivity_analysis
nodes.summary: Placeholder/stub hook for one-at-a-time sensitivity analysis that logs a warning when the feature is not yet wired in.

nodes.name: _calculate_monte_carlo
nodes.summary: Placeholder/stub hook for Monte Carlo simulation that logs a warning, returning no result until the simulation engine is connected.

nodes.name: _calculate_scenario_comparison
nodes.summary: Placeholder/stub hook for multi-scenario comparison that logs a warning when scenario comparison is requested but not implemented.

nodes.name: run_v14_pipeline_with_analytics
nodes.summary: Public entry point that runs the base V14 pipeline then conditionally layers returns, risk, sensitivity, Monte Carlo, and scenario-comparison analytics based on enable flags, returning a serialized EnhancedAnalyticsResult.

nodes.name: pipeline_v14.py
nodes.summary: Core V14 wind-to-finance pipeline that loads a scenario YAML, validates it against the schema guard, runs the WindPipeline wind-resource assessment, and exports cashflow-model inputs as JSON. The integration point between wind-resource AEP and the financial model.

nodes.name: run_v14_pipeline
nodes.summary: Loads and schema-validates the scenario config, orchestrates the WindPipeline complete assessment to produce AEP, and writes the cashflow-model export JSON; returns the assembled results dict.

nodes.name: export_to_excel.py
nodes.summary: Excel reporting script that runs the V14 pipeline and writes a multi-sheet openpyxl workbook covering annual cashflow, debt-service detail, debt covenants (DSCR/tenor), and a KPI summary. Produces the lender-facing deliverable.

nodes.name: add_annual_cashflow_sheet
nodes.summary: Builds the Annual Cashflow worksheet, laying out yearly P&L rows with revenue, OPEX, and debt-service components and styled headers/totals.

nodes.name: add_debt_service_detail_sheet
nodes.summary: Builds the Debt Service Detail worksheet, breaking each period's debt service into interest versus principal with formatted headers and merged title cells.

nodes.name: add_debt_covenants_sheet
nodes.summary: Builds the Debt Covenants worksheet, tracking DSCR by period plus debt tenor and gearing metrics drawn from the debt-sizing result.

nodes.name: add_kpi_summary_sheet
nodes.summary: Builds the KPI Summary worksheet, aggregating headline financial metrics such as total revenue, IRRs, NPV, and minimum DSCR for at-a-glance review.

nodes.name: export_to_excel
nodes.summary: Top-level driver that runs the V14 pipeline for a config, creates the workbook, adds all sheets, and saves the Excel file to the output path.

nodes.name: run_complete_analysis_fixed.py
nodes.summary: Legacy command-line runner that executes the V14 pipeline for a scenario path, saves the JSON results, and prints a formatted summary of KPIs, debt, refinancing, equity distributions, and FX. Superseded by the Hydra runners.

nodes.name: save_results
nodes.summary: Writes the pipeline results dict to a JSON file, creating the parent output directory as needed.

nodes.name: print_summary
nodes.summary: Prints a human-readable console summary of the analysis: KPIs, debt-service terms, refinancing, equity distributions, scenario FX block, and cashflow row count.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that resolves the scenario path from argv, runs the V14 pipeline, saves results, and prints the summary, exiting with an error if the scenario is missing.

nodes.name: run_wind_download_v14.py
nodes.summary: Legacy Hydra CLI that downloads ERA5 wind data for a configured location, extrapolates wind speed to hub height, writes the processed CSV, and emits JSON wind-speed statistics. Predecessor to the promoted scripts/ runner.

nodes.name: cli
nodes.summary: Hydra-decorated CLI body that selects a location, instantiates ERA5Fetcher, downloads and hub-height-extrapolates wind data, saves the CSV, and prints JSON wind-speed summary statistics.

nodes.name: run_wind_analysis_v14.py
nodes.summary: Hydra CLI (GWTF R3, JSON-first) for the complete wind-resource assessment: ERA5 download, Weibull/temporal/variability analysis, gross/net AEP at P50/P75/P90, revenue, and cashflow-model JSON export. The promoted production wind runner.

nodes.name: cli
nodes.summary: Hydra-decorated CLI body that resolves the location and turbine settings, runs the WindPipeline complete assessment, exports the chosen P-level scenario for the cashflow model, and prints JSON results.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package init for the wind-resource module, re-exporting the four public classes (ERA5Fetcher, WindAnalyzer, EnergyCalculator, WindPipeline) and the package version. Defines the module's public API surface.

nodes.name: energy_calculator.py
nodes.summary: Computes Annual Energy Production from hub-height wind-speed series using turbine power curves and a stack of loss factors, producing gross/net AEP, P50/P75/P90 scenarios, monthly energy, and tariff-based revenue. The core AEP engine.

nodes.name: EnergyCalculator
nodes.summary: Loads a turbine power curve and loss-factor config, then calculates gross AEP, net AEP with combined losses, monthly energy distribution, revenue, and a complete P-level assessment from a wind-speed DataFrame.

nodes.name: era5_fetcher.py
nodes.summary: Downloads ERA5 reanalysis wind data from the Copernicus CDS, converts NetCDF to a DataFrame, derives wind speed/direction and shear coefficient from u/v components, and extrapolates wind speed to hub height. The wind-data ingestion layer.

nodes.name: ERA5Fetcher
nodes.summary: Manages ERA5 wind-data retrieval with caching: downloads from the CDS API, converts NetCDF to a tidy DataFrame, computes wind metrics and shear alpha, extrapolates to hub height via the log law, and persists metadata.

nodes.name: wind_analyzer.py
nodes.summary: Statistical wind-resource analyzer that fits a Weibull distribution (with K-S goodness-of-fit), characterizes diurnal/seasonal/monthly patterns, and quantifies interannual variability, producing a summary report for the assessment.

nodes.name: WindAnalyzer
nodes.summary: Fits a Weibull distribution to the wind-speed series, analyzes temporal patterns (month/season/hour), computes interannual variability, and assembles summary statistics and a text report.

nodes.name: wind_pipeline.py
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the end-to-end wind-resource assessment by chaining ERA5Fetcher download, WindAnalyzer statistics, and EnergyCalculator AEP, then exporting a P-level scenario as JSON for the cashflow model. The wind-resource entry point.

nodes.name: WindPipeline
nodes.summary: Coordinates the complete wind-to-finance assessment: fetches and extrapolates ERA5 data, runs statistical analysis and energy calculations, generates a summary, and exports cashflow-model inputs for a chosen P-level scenario.

nodes.name: metrics.py
nodes.summary: Canonical v14 KPI computation engine and single source of truth for scenario-level KPI aggregation: project NPV/IRR, DSCR statistics, equity metrics, CFADS aggregates and lender KPIs.

nodes.name: _summary_stats
nodes.summary: Computes min/max/mean/median/stddev and percentile summary statistics over a numeric series, filtering non-finite values.

nodes.name: _derive_capex_usd
nodes.summary: Extracts total CAPEX in USD from a scenario config, handling case-insensitive keys and alternate cost sections.

nodes.name: _derive_cfads_series
nodes.summary: Builds the CFADS (cash flow available for debt service) series in USD from annual cashflow rows.

nodes.name: calculate_scenario_kpis
nodes.summary: Aggregates all scenario-level KPIs (project NPV/IRR, DSCR stats, equity metrics, LLCR/PLCR, lender covenants) from config, annual rows and debt results.

nodes.name: compute_kpis
nodes.summary: Thin public wrapper delegating to calculate_scenario_kpis with default discount/prudential rates and valuation inputs.

nodes.name: stress_tests_v14.py
nodes.summary: Stress-testing module that applies interest-rate, market-downturn and inflation shocks to project cashflows and reports VaR/CVaR, NPV/IRR impacts and break-even risk metrics.

nodes.name: StressResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass capturing the outcome of one stress scenario including base/stressed NPV and IRR, VaR95, CVaR95 and break-even point, with JSON serialization.

nodes.name: StressTestEngine
nodes.summary: Engine that applies interest-rate, market-downturn and inflation shocks to base cashflows, runs individual and full scenario suites, and exports stress results to JSON.

nodes.name: equity/__init__.py
nodes.summary: Public equity namespace for the v14 finance stack, re-exporting core equity metrics from equity_v14 and the distribution waterfall from equity_distribution_v14_hydra.

nodes.name: equity_distribution_v14_hydra.py
nodes.summary: Production equity distribution waterfall: builds distribution config from Hydra/OmegaConf, derives equity investment, constructs the DSCR/reserve-gated annual distribution schedule and computes equity returns.

nodes.name: EquityDistributionConfig
nodes.summary: Validated configuration dataclass for the equity distribution waterfall covering project life, equity stake, DSCR/LLCR thresholds, reserves, sweep and discount rate.

nodes.name: EquityDistributionEngine
